rows.name: Real app shapes: a library and a thin main
rows.note: inboard (about 1,070 crates) checks and runs with theme.rs, home.rs and sidebar.rs marked. Its speed is on the Bind, install, Build, Boot and Save rows. Left: native code can't call a marked fn that takes impl Fn or a named generic (#1539). A native root can't name a marked module's types (#1249).

rows.name: Bind: only what marked code names
rows.note: A cold check of inboard takes 205 s. It extracts only what marked code names (#1663, #1665). It classifies across cores (#1669). It canonicalizes across cores (#1687). Left: a grown table asks the compiler again for units it holds (#1683). Canonicalization's join and finish run on one core (#1702).

rows.name: Check after an install
rows.note: A check right after a rawr install takes 16 s on inboard. It binds no harness, resolves nothing, builds no nightly and copies nothing (#1690, #1695, #1696). It took about 7 min before. Left: an install that changes the driver still binds a harness and copies inboard's own bundle (#1701).

rows.name: Build: the runner on every core
rows.note: The runner is a workspace of a base crate and one adapter crate per imported root, so a rebuild uses several cores and a new call into one crate recompiles only that crate's adapters and the runner (#1670). A root with a very large API, such as iced, is still one crate. Left: a project that can't share rawr's runtime rebuilds rawr in the project after every install (#1493).

rows.name: Boot: a warm start compiles nothing
rows.note: A warm start reaches inboard's first app log in about 10.5 s (resolving 2.8 s, reading the API 4.8 s). A start with no edits compiles no marked file (#1638). Left: a warm start still resolves the whole program and compiles the whole generated text (#1662).

rows.name: Save: re-lower only what changed
rows.note: On inboard (0.3.213, scripted, no model in the loop): a body edit is on screen in 0.98 s, and a field change to a type native code holds restarts with no native build and settles in 2.5-2.9 s (#1755, #1865). A doc comment, an inert attribute, a blank line or a reflowed signature lowers nothing.
